fix: normalize timezone before startOfWeek calculations (fixes #68)

When dates with non-UTC timezones are passed to weekly frequency configs,
the startOfWeek() calculation could drift to a different week due to
timezone conversion shifting the date.

The fix extracts the year/month/day components and creates a new Carbon
instance at midnight in the app timezone, preserving the logical date
regardless of input timezone.

ci: fix invalid per-service `if:` conditions breaking every workflow run

Service containers don't support `if:` (only jobs/steps do), so the
matrixed single-job setup from adff2db has failed with a workflow file
error on every push/PR since 2025-11-28. Split back into one job per
database, each still matrixed over PHP 8.2-8.5, avoiding conditional
services entirely.

fix: drop PHP 8.2 support, it's unbuildable with the current toolchain

pestphp/pest ^4.0 requires PHP ^8.3, so composer install has never
been able to succeed on 8.2 despite composer.json and CI both
claiming to support it. Bump the minimum PHP to 8.3 and drop 8.2 from
the test matrix to match what's actually installable.

docs: fix README overstating minimum Laravel version to 13.0

composer.json kept orchestra/testbench ^10.0 (Laravel 12) alongside
^11.0 when Laravel 13 support was added in a00b533, so Laravel 12 is
still supported — the README's "≥13.0" was a copy mistake from that
commit. Matches what the docs site already states.

fix: use whereJsonContains for cross-database JSON comparison in ScheduleBuilder::forDate() (#77)

PostgreSQL's ->> operator returns text while SQLite's json_extract returns
native types. Using where/orWhere/orWhereJsonContains with scalar bindings
causes text=integer type mismatch on PostgreSQL.

Replace all bare where/orWhere/orwhereIn calls on JSON columns with
whereJsonContains/orWhereJsonContains, which handles type-aware binding
preparation per database driver:
- PostgreSQL: json_encode bindings + @> containment
- SQLite: raw bindings + json_each type-aware comparison
- MySQL: json_encode bindings + json_contains with path

This also replaces the string-cast fallback approach that was breaking
SQLite (json_extract returns int, comparing against string '1' fails).

Closes the PostgreSQL JSONB text binding issue for all frequency types:
days_of_month, start_month, and day_of_week.

refactor: collapse redundant duplicate days_of_month JSON clauses in forDate()

After #77 each days_of_month group was whereJsonContains(X) OR
whereJsonContains(X) — the same predicate twice.
